question: Which divine figures become subject through command and form in this rite?
premises: The command exerts authority over powerful beings.
The king of gods is included under this authority.
The love-god is also included in this form.
inference: Both the king of gods and the love-god are brought under control by the prescribed command and form.
plain_english: By this command, even the king of the gods and even the love-god are brought under control in this form.
